messages.subject: Spam messages, this support group should be moved
parts:
My suggestion,
I think you should create another Google group, apoint active administrators to keep following up the group, set the settings to moderate new members post, request to join group. Better still move out the group to a different engaging platform like discord.

With the whole lots of spam in this group in the past years I don't think Google still index this group, I know Google will ban this group for violations of Google groups terms and conditions, because there's been a lots of banned drugs and control drugs posted here and Google sees all that. While the group still stands, create another group, pin the link in this group for users to see and join the new group. Clearly indicate there that this group has been moved.

Update the sequenza sites on all platforms and website with the new support group. 

My humble opinion!
Frank.
